objective: Determine the total number of units of a specific product available today across all PowerTool branches in Graz, including branches with zero availability.

params.product_sku: lookup from product_variants matching brand='Wurth', series='Wurth Universal ZEBRA 2RS-7GT Wood and Drywall Screw', and properties: screw type wood screw, diameter 3 mm, length 30 mm, drive type torx. Use product_variant_properties to verify properties.
params.graz_store_paths: extract record_path from each store in graz_stores
params.available_quantities: for each store in graz_stores, lookup store_inventory for product_sku, default 0 if not found, sum
